anna (eng-oncall): Quick Q — where's the canonical TTFT / p50-p95-p99 dashboard for prod inference? Customer saw intermittent p99 spikes.
kevin (eng-runtime): Grafana -> Overview / Inference latency is the usual. direct link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/inf-overview/latency (bookmark it)
kevin (eng-runtime): For raw numbers use Prometheus panels: p50/p95/p99 use histogram_quantile on request_duration_bucket. Example PromQL:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le, model_version))
```
kevin (eng-runtime): TTFT we measure as `json.ttft_ms` in logs and we also surface a `time_to_first_token_ms` gauge. You can compute from buckets for first-token if needed. tokens/sec panel is:
```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model_version)
```
jess (eng-sre): if p99 alerts are noisy, group by `model_version` and `pod` and add `for: 10m`. Also consider requiring minimum traffic (increase(requests_total[15m]) > 10). pinging @anna if you have a sample trace id
anna (eng-oncall): here's a sample trace id from the incident: 7f9a2c1b — looking for traces + logs around 2026-03-15 14:21 UTC
kevin (eng-runtime): Jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.company/search?trace=7f9a2c1b
kevin (eng-runtime): Kibana quick query for logs: `service:inference AND trace.id:7f9a2c1b` — to search TTFT field: `json.ttft_ms > 0 AND environment:prod`
sam (devex): small ops suggestion: change p99 alert to something like:
```yaml
alert: HighInferenceP99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le, model_version)) > 800
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/OBS/TTFT+Runbook
```
This filters low-volume noise and attaches runbook link.
jess (eng-sre): agreed — also add a short windowed baseline check (compare to 24h median) before paging.
observability-bot: Added grafana panel bookmark for @anna :white_check_mark:
anna (eng-oncall): thanks all — I'll attach the trace + a sample request payload for postmortem. If anyone has quick pointers to tokenization causing more tokens than expected, ping me.
kevin (eng-runtime): FYI sometimes quantized models change token pacing — check tokens/sec per `model_version` panel and look for spikes in `tokens_emitted_total`
sam (devex): Happy to add the Grafana + Jaeger links into the incident page and update alert thresholds after the triage. assigning to @sam :handshake:
